name: Last Throne
description: Final boss as a one-shot, phrygian at 152 bpm (the flat 2nd is menace). Mostly 4/4 but every fourth bar drops a beat to 3/4, which makes it lurch. Intro, verse, climbing pre-chorus, chorus, bridge, then a last chorus a semitone up and faster, ending in a big resolve.
